policies.duplicate_positions: exact numeric equality of all three raw local coordinate values; signed zero and equal int/float values equal; no rounding, tolerance, scaling or transform before grouping
policies.duplicate_position_clusters: one equivalence class of two or more source vertex indices; no connectivity merge
policies.duplicate_polygons: same original vertex-index cycle modulo cyclic rotation and reversal; equal vertex sets with different cycles or coincident geometry with different indices are not duplicate polygons
policies.duplicate_polygon_clusters: one full equivalence class of two or more source polygon indices; do not merge classes sharing an edge
policies.winding_conflicts: exactly two distinct raw polygon incidents traverse a source edge in the same direction; direction is source-index order, independent of coordinate degeneracy, edge storage orientation or outward normal
policies.winding_unknown: edges with more than two polygon incidents are unclassified with original edge index prefix and nonmanifold_edge_orientation_ambiguous reason; zero or one incident has no pairwise conflict
policies.winding_clusters: connected components of flagged original edges only; do not connect through unclassified edges
policies.unknown_coexistence: retain known flagged edge groups, total null and category partial when any edge is unclassified; do not hide duplicate-face winding facts because vertex links are unknown
policies.positions: existing source-bound full-patch local/world bounds and witness; duplicate position vertex / duplicate polygon face / winding edge element kinds
policies.default: legacy three categories unchanged; new capabilities explicitly requested
policies.protocol: retain v2 shape, advance fixed algorithm revision and capability/helper SHA together
policies.excluded: no near-duplicate welding, outwardness, global orientability, damage inference, geometry modification or repair

quality.unknown: keep partial known-fact rows and explicit unknown rows in full task accounting; never count as normal

budgets: all existing M1-01 work/count/bytes/original deadline limits unchanged; oversized equivalence classes omitted whole
